description: Land Acquisition - Parana Halpe, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the government's intention to acquire several plots of land (Lots 90-97) for public purpose, providing detailed descriptions of each land parcel including location, extent, and claimant information. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative actions.
